name: Gareth Llewellyn
bio:
Gareth's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, after a career in public sector HR. A lifelong motorsport enthusiast, he volunteered at local rally events, eventually leveraging his HR experience to assist smaller racing teams with compliance and recruitment. Recognizing a significant need for professional HR practices within the often chaotic world of motorsport, Gareth made the leap to Herberth Motorsport five years ago. 

At Herberth, Gareth is known for his meticulous approach to talent acquisition and employee relations. He champions a fair and transparent workplace, firmly believing that a happy and supported team performs at its best. He is particularly skilled at identifying and nurturing young talent, ensuring the team has a strong pipeline of skilled individuals for the future. His methodical nature has brought a new level of professionalism to the team.

Gareth is a firm believer that a strong, unified team is just as crucial as the engineering beneath the car. He always has time to listen to employees' issues and concerns, and this has led to a company culture which is very supportive and inclusive.

physical.description: A stout man with a kindly face and a perpetual air of calm about him.

quirks: Always has a supply of Welsh cakes in his office for visitors.
Insists on using a fountain pen for all official documents.
Can often be heard humming traditional Welsh hymns while working.
